name: discover/related-rail
title: RelatedRail
summary: "More like this" under one item's page: a titled section of DiscoverCards, a scroll-snap rail on phones and a grid on wide screens, hidden entirely when there are no items.

props.name: title
props.description: The rail's heading, e.g. "More events in Harare".

props.name: id
props.description: The section's id; its heading is `<id>-title`. Unique per page.

props.name: items
props.description: The related items, as DiscoverCard props (variant, href, title, …). Empty hides the whole rail.

props.name: level
props.description: The heading level; the cards' titles are one level under it.

props.name: seeAllHref
props.description: Where "See all" goes; no link without it.

props.name: seeAllLabel
props.description: Say what "all" is, e.g. "See every event in Harare".

behaviour: A <section> labelled by its heading, so it is a named region; the list is labelled by the same heading.
Each item is a DiscoverCard (its own <li>), its title one heading level under the rail's.

Under 48rem the list is one row that scrolls inside itself, cards 18rem wide and snapping to their start; it is keyboard-focusable (tabindex 0) so the row can be scrolled without a pointer, and the page never scrolls sideways. From 48rem it is a grid of two columns, three from 64rem.
No items, nothing rendered: no heading, no empty band.

default.description: Events near the one on the page.

items.title: Harare International Festival of the Arts

seeall.description: Under an h2 band: an h3 rail with a See all link.

keyboard: Tab reaches "See all", then the list (arrow keys scroll it on phones), then each card's title link and actions.
focus: The list and every link show the `--ring` focus outline.
aria: aria-labelledby names the region and the list by the heading.

theming.brandOverlay: None of its own; the cards' monogram and `brand` badge tone tint with `--primary`.

noJs.without: Everything: the rail scrolls with CSS scroll-snap; the component is server-rendered HTML with no script.

responsive: Under 48rem: one row of 18rem cards that scrolls inside itself with scroll-snap; the page never scrolls sideways.
From 48rem: a grid, two columns; three from 64rem.
contract:
contract
  slot is "related-rail"
  uses related-rail-list
  uses discover-card
  a "See every running circle" min_height 48
  when default shows h2 "More events in Harare"
  when default shows h3 "Poetry at the Book Café"
  when seeall shows h3 "Circles like this one"
  when seeall shows h4 "Borrowdale Striders"
end

checks.say: A region labelled by its heading.
Card titles are one level under the rail.
A scroll-snap rail on phones, keyboard-focusable.
An h3 rail has h4 cards.
